entities.name: Admiral Makarov National University of Shipbuilding
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Admiral Makarov National University of Shipbuilding, abbr. NUS, in Mykolaiv is a higher education institution which trains specialists for the shipbuilding and allied industries of Ukraine. The university is named after Russian admiral Stepan Makarov, who was born in the city.
